description: Áreas de descanso en carretera en Extremadura is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Extremadura. List of rest areas located in the Autonomous Community of Extremadura. Coverage: Junta de Extremadura. The portal shows the English title as "Roadside rest areas in Extremadura" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Junta de Extremadura. The listing shows 2025-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
